display_long_description:
# Feel the Beat, Strike the Enemy, Fight the Boss!

Punch to the beat, deflect bullets, and fight enemies in a VR rhythm boxing game.

**NEW in v1.8 — Train, Track, and Keep Coming Back**
🔥 Weekly Streak — Play once a week to keep your streak alive; your flame evolves through 10 stages, up to the one-year Eternal Flame.
🏅 69 Achievements & 19 Ranks — Earn badges across six categories and climb the ranks, shown as a color-changing octagon gem on your hand. Unlock exclusive wristbands as rank rewards.
📊 Fitness Dashboard — Track calories and total hits with weekly and monthly trends and your best records. Make every session a real workout.

Strike with your fists, deflect bullets, dodge explosive attacks, and face powerful bosses in intense rhythm combat. Vibe Punch blends real music with fast-paced combat for a unique VR boxing experience.

**🥊 Standard Mode - Freestyle boxing rhythm combat**
[media]

**⚔️ Boss Mode - Giant boss battles, brutal intensity**
[media]

**⚡ Bullet Deflection - Punch bullets, defeat enemies**
[media]

**🏆 Progress & Fitness - Streaks, ranks & a real workout dashboard**
[media]

**💥 Power-Shot - Powerful smash for bonus scoring**
[media]

**🛡️ Block Enemy Lasers - Raise your fist to shield from laser beams**
[media]

And

- 🌐 Dynamic Battlefield - Reacts to rhythm and punches
- 💣 Dodge Deadly Bombs - Avoid explosive threats
- 🎵 40 real tracks (more coming soon) - Build your own album
- 😌 No-Fail Mode - Enjoy every track without pressure
- ✨ Striking neon visuals and satisfying haptics
